decisions.reason: Although the consumer superfood drink sits farthest from the firm's industrial core, it gained its own page in 2019, so the firm has visibly committed to it and can blame weak sales on temporary market-entry causes, which favours keeping it.

The modular waste-to-energy extensions build directly on the established offer and are central to the firm's announced sustainable-technology direction, with heavy engineering investment that management will defend.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has had a dedicated page since launch, reflecting strong public commitment and sunk development costs in a core area, so management will persist with it.

The plastic-to-fuel plant was raised to its own page in 2019 and embodies the firm's disruptive waste-to-value mission, so escalating commitment makes dropping it unlikely despite slow commercialization.
